selection.ownership: Agiled is a product of ZTABS (Private) Limited (Abbottabad, Pakistan) with a listed Houston, Texas correspondence address. Official product copy states 16,000+ businesses across 130+ countries. The reviewed edition is the public REST API at my.agiled.app, not a mainland-China product. Pakistani ownership of a global edition is not EXCLUDE.

research.searchCoverage: Official Agiled API v1 OpenAPI (api_token query + Brand header to https://my.agiled.app/api/v1), GET /users, /contacts, /contact/{id}, /projects, /tasks, knowledge-base API key article, company identity (ZTABS / Abbottabad, listed Houston address), and dated incident search (Agiled.app + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. A marketing FAQ claiming Bearer auth disagrees with OpenAPI and the pinned source; native follows OpenAPI. No qualifying Agiled platform incident found in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Agiled OpenAPI at https://api.agiled.app/docs documents server https://my.agiled.app/api/v1 with required api_token query and Brand account-URL header. GET /users is the pinned credential probe. GET /contacts, /contact/{id}, /projects, and /tasks are documented reads. Marketing FAQ Bearer-auth copy is not followed. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Agiled platform compromise in reviewed coverage. Composio AGILED 18-tool deepen (2026-10-07) added official OpenAPI writes and remaining list GETs: POST /expenses, /projects, /tasks, /tickets; GET /currencies, /crm/deals, /employees, /estimates, /expenses, /invoices, /products, /project-category, /tickets, /timelogs/{project_id}, /users.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

contacts.get.description: Get one Agiled CRM contact by ID.
contacts.get.title: Get contact

contacts.list.description: List Agiled CRM contacts via GET /contacts. Optional page, per_page, and search match AGILED_GET_CONTACTS.

per_page.description: Number of contacts to retrieve per page (must be >= 1).

search.description: Search query to filter contacts by name or email.

contacts.list.title: List contacts

currencies.list.description: List currencies configured for the Agiled account via GET /currencies. Maps to AGILED_GET_CURRENCIES.
currencies.list.title: List currencies

deals.list.description: List CRM deals via GET /crm/deals. Maps to AGILED_GET_DEALS.
deals.list.title: List deals

employees.list.description: List employees via GET /employees. Maps to AGILED_GET_EMPLOYEES.
employees.list.title: List employees

estimates.list.description: List estimates via GET /estimates. Optional page and per_page match AGILED_GET_ESTIMATES.

per_page.description: Number of estimates to retrieve per page (must be >= 1).

estimates.list.title: List estimates

expenses.create.description: Create an expense via POST /expenses. Maps to AGILED_CREATE_EXPENSE.

currency_id.description: Currency ID used for the expense.

distance_category.description: Category or purpose of the distance expense.

distance_description.description: Additional notes about the distance traveled.

distance_unit.description: Unit for distance (e.g. kilometer or mile).

distance_unit_rate.description: Rate per distance unit (must be non-negative).

distance_value.description: Distance traveled, numeric value (must be non-negative).

next_purchase_date.description: Next scheduled date for recurring expense (YYYY-MM-DD).

price.description: Price of the expense (must be non-negative).

purchase_date.description: Date when the expense was made (YYYY-MM-DD).

purchased_from.description: Vendor or source of the expense.

term_duration.description: Unit for recurrence intervals (e.g. day, week, month).

user_id.description: User ID of the expense owner.

expenses.create.title: Create expense

expenses.list.description: List expenses via GET /expenses. Maps to AGILED_GET_EXPENSES.
expenses.list.title: List expenses

healthcheck.description: Validate the Agiled API token by listing users.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

invoices.list.description: List invoices via GET /invoices. Maps to AGILED_GET_INVOICES.
invoices.list.title: List invoices

products.list.description: List products via GET /products. Maps to AGILED_GET_PRODUCTS.
products.list.title: List products

projectCategories.list.description: List project categories via GET /project-category. Maps to AGILED_GET_PROJECT_CATEGORIES.
projectCategories.list.title: List project categories

projects.create.description: Create a project via POST /projects. Maps to AGILED_CREATE_PROJECT.

allow_client_notification.description: Whether the client should receive notifications (1 or 0).

client_view_task.description: Whether the client can view tasks (1 or 0).

currency_id.description: Currency ID for the project budget.

deadline.description: Deadline of the project in YYYY-MM-DD format.

manual_time_log.description: Whether manual time log is enabled (1 or 0).

notes.description: Internal notes or comments for the project.

start_date.description: Start date of the project in YYYY-MM-DD format.

projects.create.title: Create project

tasks.create.description: Create a task via POST /tasks. Maps AGILED_CREATE_TASK title to official heading and assigned_to to user_id.

assigned_to.description: User ID to assign this task to (official user_id).

billable.description: Whether the task is billable (1 or 0).

due_date.description: Due date of the task in YYYY-MM-DD format.

followers.description: List of user IDs who will follow the task.

list_id.description: ID of the task list/column (e.g. backlog, in_progress).

project_id.description: ID of the project to which this task belongs.

start_date.description: Start date of the task in YYYY-MM-DD format.

title.description: Title or summary of the task (official heading).

tasks.create.title: Create task

tickets.create.description: Create a support ticket via POST /tickets. Maps AGILED_CREATE_TICKET message onto official description and message.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent assigned to this ticket.

channel_id.description: ID of the communication channel (e.g. email, chat).

message.description: Initial message describing the issue (also sent as official description).

type_id.description: ID of the ticket type or category.

user_id.description: ID of the user creating the ticket.

tickets.create.title: Create ticket

tickets.list.description: List support tickets via GET /tickets. Maps to AGILED_GET_TICKETS.
tickets.list.title: List tickets

timesheets.list.description: List time logs for a project via GET /timelogs/{project_id}. Maps to AGILED_GET_TIMESHEETS.

project_id.description: ID of the project to retrieve timesheets for (must be >= 1).

timesheets.list.title: List timesheets

users.list.description: List users via GET /users. Maps to AGILED_GET_USERS. Distinct from healthcheck, which uses the same path as a credential probe.
users.list.title: List users
